galleryChanges.before:
Project Overview

We installed a 77-inch LG G6 above a fireplace faced with stone veneer. A recessed media box provides space for the outlet, surge protector and Apple TV behind the television, allowing the screen to sit close to the stone surface.

Installation Details

The stone veneer required diamond drill bits and a diamond grinder disc during preparation. The recessed box keeps the supporting equipment behind the TV rather than on a separate shelf.

  • TV: 77-inch LG G6
  • Mounting surface: stone veneer above a fireplace
  • Equipment: recessed media box, outlet, surge protector and Apple TV
